title: Reinventing Organizations
summary: Frederic Laloux presents his research on self-managing, purpose-driven organizations, followed by Q&A. He summarizes the findings of his book Reinventing Organizations and examples such as Buurtzorg.
why: Recommended as the best introduction to self-management and new management paradigms.

quote.text: I can highly recommend watching this video if you're interested in self-management and the idea of a new management paradigm
